text:
Zoe: Heads-up  Mayfair Diagnostics trial is blocked during onboarding. Their embedding quota hits 429s when creating initial model-backed search index. Support opened SUP-11001. Theyve got a renewal health check in 5 days, marking as high priority. :rotating_light:
Priya: can you paste the error and how many affected seats? Ill prep comms if this looks like renewal-risk.
Zoe: log snippet:
```
2026-05-05T10:03:12Z WARN embeddings.create status=429 reason=quota_exceeded tenant=mayfair
2026-05-05T10:03:13Z INFO retry=1 backoff=200ms
```
Zoe: they tried to index ~120k tokens across 3 projects; UI shows "Indexing failed".
Marcus: we tightened per-tenant concurrent embedding streams last week. Looks like their onboarding spike exceeded the new concurrency gate.
Han: mitigation options: 1) bump tenant embedding concurrency to allow this initial index (temporary), or 2) guide them to stage the index in smaller batches. Which do they prefer?
Zoe: customer wants a fast unblock so they can finish setup before the renewal review.
Marcus: I can increase tenant.embeddings_concurrency to +10 for 2 hours and add audit. Doing it now.
OpsBot: quota.update tenant=mayfair embeddings_concurrency=+10 window=2h (by Marcus)
Marcus: updated. Zoe - please ask them to retry.
Zoe: Mayfair retried and indexing finished for all projects. They report UI moved to "Ready". :white_check_mark:
Priya: drafting customer note (non-technical): "Hi Emma  we're sorry for the interruption during setup. We applied a temporary change to allow your indexing to finish while we implement a permanent onboarding profile to handle larger initial imports. We'll follow up when the fix is live and can run a 30-minute walkthrough to confirm everything. As a courtesy for the disruption we'd like to offer a one-time onboarding credit.  Priya, Customer Success"
Marcus: tech plan: create an "onboarding spike" quota profile so initial large indexes are allowed a higher burst for 1 hour and add CI test coverage. ETA 2026-05-06 09:00 PT. Ill own release and rollback.
Zoe: calendar invite sent to Emma + their eng contact; SUP-11001 link in event notes.
Priya: note renewal_risk -> moved to "priority outreach" until post-release confirmation. Tracking: 1) Implement onboarding spike profile (Marcus) ETA 2026-05-06 09:00 PT, 2) Revert temp concurrency bump after verification (Marcus), 3) Post-release customer follow-up (Priya), 4) 30-min walkthrough (Zoe).
Marcus: will post release notes and flip the quota back after checks.
Zoe: closing SUP-11001 as workaround validated. Account health: at-risk -> recovering. Thanks team :handshake:
